summary.text: Fred Gardner is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 9 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A veterinarian and farmer/rancher, he is the only candidate listed for the seat in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Fred Gardner was born in Emporia, Kansas, graduated from Hartford High School and graduated from Kansas State University in 1978.
His career experience includes owning a business and working as a veterinarian and as a farmer and rancher.
Gardner assumed office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2023, succeeding Kent Thompson.
